instruction: Take a photo of what's showing in VLC right now and save it as 'current_frame.png' on Desktop.

parameters.window_name: Interstellar Movie - Interstellar Movie - Official Trailer - VLC media player

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.verification: Task requires taking a VLC screenshot and saving to current_frame.png. Evaluator checks if file exists at /home/user/Desktop/current_frame.png.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator only checks file existence, not whether file is actually an image or contains VLC screenshot content
Instruction requires 'taking a photo' of VLC and saving as PNG, but evaluator cannot verify the file is an image or contains correct content
A user could create any file at that path and pass verification
However, file existence at the correct path is the most practical verification for this task type given environment constraints
Getter logic correctly uses bash 'test -f' to check file existence on VM
Metric logic correctly compares boolean result with expected value
Expected value (exists: true) is semantically correct for this task
Evaluator will execute without runtime errors and provide basic verification
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding file type verification: check if file is a valid PNG image format
Consider adding file size validation: screenshot should have reasonable file size (e.g., > 1KB)
